commonInput.workspaceId: required opaque ID; every input record/evidence must have equal workspace_id
commonInput.evidence: array of closed neutral evidence records; absent means missing, never verified
commonInput.asOf: explicit UTC ISO timestamp; omitted/invalid is unknown freshness
commonInput.maxAgeMs: explicit positive safe integer; omitted/zero is unknown policy
commonInput.requestedUse: MANAGER_REVIEW by default; unsupported/forbidden use is blocked by original consumer boundary

sourceOwnerSemantics: conceptual source domains, not upload actors or a new official ownership registry
completionRequires: valid interview id, application_id and candidate_id; supplied context must agree
verified fresh neutral evidence for interview ID
metricsInput: records[] of {candidate, application, events}; snapshots rebuilt via adapter, caller-supplied engine results ignored
historySemantics: supplied evidence-bearing bounded event history, not a claim of exhaustive productive history; no/invalid/stale events yield unknown counts

failureModes.WORKSPACE_MISMATCH: a consumed record/evidence has foreign or missing workspace_id
failureModes.SUBJECT_MISMATCH: supplied application/candidate context disagrees with event/interview/application
failureModes.EVIDENCE_CONFLICT: same evidence ID has incompatible normalized metadata
failureModes.EVENT_CONFLICT: same event ID has incompatible projected data or occurs under different applications in a metrics batch
failureModes.UNSUPPORTED_EVIDENCE_FIELDS: closed evidence/verification contract rejects extra fields; values never echoed

limitations: verification metadata is supplied evidence, not independently authenticated by these pure adapters
